events.title: Cline makes changed files and failure recovery visible across desktop and extension
events.title_zh: Cline 同步增强改动可见性与失败恢复
events.summary: Cline Desktop 0.0.49 adds changed-file views, a project tree, read-only viewer, terminal and local-model management. Desktop and extension 4.1.26 both cap model retries, recover turns that disconnect after reasoning, prevent repeated compaction with unknown context size and fix Gemini API-key failures that could drop tools.
events.why_it_matters: For coding-agent users, the release exposes what changed and hardens several failure paths that can otherwise duplicate work or strand a turn. Reliability improvements are release-note claims and still need regression tests against real repositories.
events.summary_zh: Cline Desktop 0.0.49 加入改动文件视图、项目树、只读查看器、终端和本地模型管理。Desktop 与 extension 4.1.26 同时限制模型重试次数，恢复只输出 reasoning 后断线的回合，避免未知上下文大小触发反复压缩，并修复可能丢失全部工具的 Gemini API key 故障。

Desktop and extension 4.1.26 both cap model retries, recover turns that disconnect after reasoning, prevent repeated compaction with unknown context size and fix Gemini API-key failures that could drop tools.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对 coding agent 用户来说，新版既让“改了哪些文件”更可见，也修补了可能重复执行或卡住回合的故障路径。这些可靠性改进仍来自发布说明，需要在真实仓库做回归。

technical_details.failure_controls: Maximum three model retries; reasoning-only disconnect recovery; bounded compaction
technical_details.workflow: Changed-files pane, project tree, viewer and terminal

technical_details_zh.故障控制: 模型最多重试三次；恢复只输出 reasoning 后断线的回合；限制反复压缩
technical_details_zh.工作流: 改动文件面板、项目树、查看器与终端
technical_details_zh.时间依据: GitHub releases 分别发布于 2026-10-26T04:49:34Z 与 2026-10-26T09:06:50Z
